metadata.title: Contact | Happy Horse AI
metadata.description: Reach the Happy Horse AI team for general support, billing questions, creator partnerships, or content concerns. We read every message personally and respond within 24 hours on business days.
metadata.keywords: happy horse ai contact, happy horse ai support, happyhorse-ai.app support

contact.page_description: We read every message personally and respond within 24 hours on business days. To help us help you faster, include your account email and any generation IDs or error details in your first message.

cards.title: General Support
cards.description: Email [support@happyhorse-ai.app](mailto:support@happyhorse-ai.app) when you run into upload errors, generation failures, or unexpected output quality. We recommend checking the [Blog](/blog) for step-by-step troubleshooting guides before writing in — most common issues are covered there.

cards.title: Billing & Credits
cards.description: For questions about credit deductions, subscription changes, payment failures, or refund eligibility, contact [support@happyhorse-ai.app](mailto:support@happyhorse-ai.app). You can cross-check what is included in each plan and how credits are counted on the [Pricing page](/pricing) and [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service).

cards.title: Creator & Media Partnerships
cards.description: We work with content creators, agencies, and press. Reach us at [support@happyhorse-ai.app](mailto:support@happyhorse-ai.app) with a brief description of your platform and audience. Before sharing any materials, review our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) to understand how we handle shared assets.

cards.title: Content & Safety
cards.description: If you believe a generation violates our usage policy or need expedited removal, email [support@happyhorse-ai.app](mailto:support@happyhorse-ai.app) with the generation ID and reason for the request. For a full overview of our moderation standards, visit the [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service) and [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

resources.title: Self-Service Resources
items: Browse workflow guides and troubleshooting articles on the [Blog](/blog).
Compare credit costs, plan limits, and queue priority on the [Pricing page](/pricing).
Understand data handling and retention via the [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) and [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service).

response_times.title: Typical Response Times
response_times.note: If you have not received a reply within these windows, reply to your original email rather than sending a new one — it will be automatically moved back to the front of the queue.
